rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for sweat as bodily moisture.

example.english: I'm covered in sweat after running.
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 hon6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone emitting sweat.

example.english: I sweat all over after exercising.
example.traditional: 做完運動我成身都出汗。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 ngo5 seng4 san1 dou1 ceot1 hon6

rows.note: Use this for worrying rather than physically sweating or working hard.

example.english: I sweat with worry about tomorrow's exam.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1 ting1 jat6 go3 haau2 si3

rows.note: Use this when someone is working extremely hard or desperately, often with 做 understood or stated.

example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bok3 meng6 zou6

rows.note: Use this causative pattern when something makes a person sweat.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tin1 hei3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ceot1 hon6
